purpose: A2.5 delivery 1: freeze the replay requests, their float32 references and the written integration fixtures for the headset replay, built on the PC from existing artifacts only; no model runs here

inputs.small_run_manifest_rule: r006's full manifest hash is the one the pinned A2.3d scores manifest records under inputs.small_run_manifest_sha256; it must begin with the recorded prefix

rules.a23e_case: costs.select_cases over the request index, each chosen parent/view pair's requests in request order, expanded exactly as cache.py does
rules.a23e_audit: audit.audit_parents over the request index, each parent's requests in request order, expanded exactly as audit.py does
rules.longest_in_format: for each format, across both views, the request with the largest (input tokens of model_key, request index): the runs' canary rule applied within each format, so ties go to the later request

selection.order: request index; a request chosen by several sources appears once and lists every source
selection.list_encoding: request IDs in order, UTF-8, one LF after every ID including the last

boundaries.keep_before_last_token: keep the first n - 1 of n tokens (a repeated identical request); verified when the prompt's text before the last token re-tokenizes to exactly those n - 1 tokens
boundaries.keep_before_command_line: keep the tokens before the document's last line, which must be the command line {"command": ...}; verified when the prompt's text before that line re-tokenizes to an exact prefix of the frozen tokens

headset.input_check_rule: the checks run in this order and the first failure decides the outcome: prompt_bytes and mapping and token_ids fail as invalid_input, tokenization as tokenization_mismatch, context as context_budget_exceeded; a request that passes all five is evaluated

written_fixtures.label: written_integration_fixture: an implementation check written for A2.5, not dataset data and not a benchmark (D99(5)); each stops at one input check, before any evaluation
written_fixtures.overflow_rule: filler lines numbered 1, 2, ... go before the command line; the fewest that make the prompt's tokens plus the continuation exceed the context limit

fixtures.change: the overflow document: the fewest filler lines that exceed the context limit
the stored bytes have the command text's first letter upper-cased; prompt_sha256 stays the original prompt's
the choice K/ASK is listed first instead of last; mapping_sha256 is recomputed for the changed lists
code A carries token ID 33 instead of the protocol's 32; mapping_sha256 is recomputed for the changed lists
the last token ID becomes vocab_size; token_ids_sha256 is recomputed for the changed list
